correctness.rationale: The compact sinc kernel A has an isolated simple positive leading eigenvalue under B ell<1. Exact reflection gives A±C_L. Resolvent perturbation cancels the quadratic term in the parity-branch difference; the uniform cross-kernel Taylor series gives the two displayed coefficients. Its derivative has a fixed sign on each resonance window for large n, giving a unique transverse zero, exact two-dimensional maximal eigenspace and the n^{-1} shifted location. The numerical checker is only supplementary.

value.rationale: A structural, motivated regime: when observing a bandlimited signal on two disjoint identical windows, exact optimal-state nonuniqueness and parity switching occur infinitely often as separation varies. The moment-dependent shift is a nontrivial shape invariant beyond the leading oscillation and gives a quantitative resonance law.
